slides.sub: the unwritten law of the dancefloor

slides.text: It wasn't written by a philosopher.
slides.sub: It was shouted from a stage.
A fight breaks out in the middle of a rave.

slides.quote: Show some peace, love and unity — or I'll break your faces.
slides.note: Frankie Bones. He threatened them into peace.

slides.sub: The fourth pillar. PLUR was complete.
Kandi beads, traded hand to hand.

slides.cta: Save this. Pass it on — hand to hand.
